prompts: Create a production game sprite atlas: ONE wide 3:1 PNG image with genuinely transparent alpha background, three equal square cells in a horizontal row, NO text, NO dividers. Each cell depicts exactly the SAME cozy cottage at the SAME scale, identical elevated three-quarter camera (35 degree downward view, front and RIGHT side visible), identical front door ground pixel anchor within its cell. Reference input is house identity and material quality. TRANSFER cream painted wood walls, round blue door, white circular window, handcrafted scalloped pink/yellow/cobalt ceramic tiles, stone step, chimney, tactile high quality sunny 3D miniature. DO NOT TRANSFER teddy, garden, grass base, flowers on ground, trees, props, studio backdrop. Isolate architecture only with transparent holes and edges. Left: the smallest first-stage cottage, no canopy. Middle: SAME first cottage plus short wooden entrance canopy, retain wall/roof/door dimensions. Right: SAME middle cottage plus a RIGHT side wooden terrace with railings and a small striped canopy covering BACK HALF ONLY. Front half of terrace completely OPEN to sky and camera, empty floor, NO table or chairs or residents because game will place them separately. Terrace is addition, cottage core never gets stretched. Largest right building fits its square with 8% margin, other houses occupy less width at constant scale. In each cell the original cottage doorway anchor is 38% of cell width, 80% of cell height. No ground plane or cast shadows outside building. No fake checkerboard, white matte or colored background. True alpha transparency. No characters, words, logos, decorative symbols beyond original round blue door. Preserve material detail visible at small scale.

Precise background removal edit. The input wrongly has a baked gray checkerboard. REMOVE the entire checkerboard and make all background pixels truly transparent in the output PNG ALPHA CHANNEL, including holes between terrace rails and below canopy. DO NOT paint a checkerboard, white, gray, or any other backdrop. Keep the three house sprites exactly unchanged in position, color, scale, details and original 3:1 image dimensions. This is an alpha cutout asset, not an illustration of transparency. Output RGBA PNG with transparent alpha background. No other changes.
